class.name: OcgShapeanalysisCurve
class.brief_description: Analyzing tool for 2d or 3d curve. Computes parameters of projected point onto a curve.
class.description: ! Analyzing tool for 2d or 3d curve. ! Computes parameters of projected point onto a curve.

method.name: Project
method.description: Projects a Point on a Curve. Computes the projected point and its parameter on the curve. <preci> is used as 3d precision (hence, 0 will produce reject unless exact confusion). The number of iterations is limited.

method.name: NextProject
method.description: Projects a Point on a Curve using Newton method. <paramPrev> is taken as the first approximation of solution. If Newton algorithm fails the method Project() is used.
